steps.title: Ecosystem & Trend Analysis
steps.text: mapped the Nordic music industry landscape, emerging digital trends, and opportunities for data democratization.

steps.title: Service Vision 1.0
steps.text: defined the initial hypothesis: simplifying complex streaming and financial data for artists.

steps.title: Artist & Stakeholder Interviews
steps.text: uncovered real user pain points, needs, and attitudes toward data and career management.

steps.title: Artist Profiles & Design Drivers
steps.text: identified four user archetypes and translated insights into key design principles.

steps.title: Opportunity Prioritization
steps.text: outlined strategic directions balancing artist needs and business feasibility.

steps.title: Updated Service Vision
steps.text: reframed the concept around transparency, wellbeing, and data ownership.

steps.title: Cost–Benefit & Scalability Assessment
steps.text: analyzed business potential and platform scalability across user groups.

steps.title: Concept & Prototype Design
steps.text: co-created wireframes and data dashboards for both artist and admin views.

steps.title: Prototype Testing
steps.text: gathered feedback from artists and PME teams to refine usability, tone, and information hierarchy.

steps.title: Development Sprint Planning
steps.text: defined roadmap for MVP implementation and long-term evolution of the platform.
